This project uses Yahoo finance data on the top US stock indexes, Treasury Bill Yield indexes, and individual stocks in the S & P 500, retrieved with the tidyquant package. This data set filters data only for the S&P 500. 

### Variables: `sp500.csv`

`symbol` : Stock symbol

`date` : Trading day (YYYY-MM-DD)

`event` : Variable indicating whether the reported price is opening, highest, lowest, closest, or adjusted price

`price` : Traded price of the stock on the date (US dollars)
